title: Damad-e Khosh Ghadam
overview: Siavash, the owner of a small clothing workshop, decides to get married after constant encouragement from his mother and close friend. However, after unexpectedly leaving his first marriage proposal, he is cursed by the bride's family. From that moment on, every new marriage proposal leads to a series of humorous and unexpected events, turning his search for love into a string of comedic misadventures.
